stepExplanation: Adrenaline causes: (1) **Increased heart rate** - pumps more blood to muscles, (2) **Dilation of airways** - increases oxygen intake, (3) **Release of glucose from liver** - provides energy, (4) **Blood diverted to muscles** from digestive system, (5) **Dilated pupils** - improves vision.
